cases.description: Accepted requirements and architecture need an ordered plan before code changes begin.
expected: Builds phases around independently verifiable outcomes
Maps requirements to concrete plan steps
Recommends a safe first executable unit

cases.description: A previously accepted plan must be updated after one approved architecture decision changes sequencing.
expected: Revises dependency order to match the new decision

cases.description: The request asks for sequencing across a material architecture choice that has not been accepted yet.
expected: Avoids presenting speculative sequencing as approved

cases.description: The plan identifies useful code changes that would solve part of the problem immediately.
expected: Keeps the task in planning scope
Records implementation work as ordered actions rather than executing it
Separates approved planning from future execution

cases.description: The request is for one straightforward file edit with no meaningful sequencing problem.
expected: Declines to impose a formal implementation plan on a trivial direct edit
Avoids overhead that does not improve safety or clarity
prohibited: Creating a multi-phase implementation plan for a trivial one-step change
